@andreypanasenko Just to let you know: I've made a Junit test case with the following idea.

On client side, I've created an attribute with the following content:
String sdata0 = "aaa"; => correctly decoded
String sdata2 = "aaa\r\r"; => correctly decoded
String sdata1 = "aaa\r"; => incorrectly decoded (one extra \r added)
String sdata3 = "aaa\r\r\r"; => incorrectly decoded (one extra \r added)

Is that your issue? (I think so, but just to confirm)
